articles.title: Toronto fire chief welcomes new lithium-ion regulations in record-setting year for battery fires
articles.summary: Toronto's fire chief says new regulations from Queen's Park to ban people from modifying lithium-ion batteries are a welcome "first step." The city has already seen more than 120 blazes sparked by the batteries this year alone.

articles.title: Multiple pedestrians struck, 1 critically injured in Richmond Hill collision
articles.summary: Four pedestrians have been taken to hospital after a collision in Richmond Hill Thursday afternoon. York regional police say the crash happened at the intersection of Major Mackenzie Drive and Newkirk Road around 3:15 p.m. One person was taken to a trauma centre with life-threatening injuries while three others were taken to a local hospital […]

articles.title: Victim in fatal North York stabbing identified: police
articles.summary: A woman who was fatally stabbed in an incident that left two people dead has been identified by Toronto police.

articles.title: 2 arrested, police searching for suspect after Mississauga apartment building allegedly set on fire twice
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and police are searching for a third in connection with two fires they allege were deliberately set in September at a Mississauga apartment building.

articles.title: U.S.-made pipes are being installed next to Ontario's legislature as Canadian steel jobs vanish
articles.summary: As Canadian governments push to improve local supply chains amidst an ongoing trade war with the United States, the City of Toronto has been forced to head south of the border. Officials say only American companies make the steel pipes they are currently installing near Queen's Park.

articles.title: Amazon workers in Toronto area launch organizing drive with help of Unifor
articles.summary: A group of Amazon employees packed a hall in Scarborough on Wednesday to launch an organizing drive across fulfillment centres in the Greater Toronto Area with the help of Canada's largest private sector union.

articles.title: Woman dead after being struck by vehicle in Newmarket, police say
articles.summary: A woman in her 20s has died after being struck by a vehicle in Newmarket, Ont., on Wednesday evening, police say.

articles.title: Canadian military flying ace William Barker commemorated with new statue on Yonge Street
articles.summary: A new statue of a Canadian World War I flying ace was unveiled in Toronto Wednesday afternoon, the latest effort to breathe life into his memory, which his grandson said was nearly lost to time.
